method: Independently reviewed all 64 target envelopes against original source pages before derivation, then inspected all eight final native PDF pages at 150 dpi and source/output crop comparisons. The final exact eight changed rectangles equal the independently reviewed tight reference bounds; 56 automatic rectangles are unchanged. All 64 target envelopes and 42 copied source fragments pass a 216 dpi source comparison, with independent full-source CoreGraphics serialization for this vector source. These pixel and containment checks verify nominated regions; musical ownership/completeness depends on source visual review, not geometry alone.

cropSelection.setup: Instrument names, Lyrics flags, horizontal x38..578 settings, system association and copied source bar-number metadata were reviewed setup; this is not a claim of automatic instrument recognition or automatic source-label attribution.

limitations: Eight rectangles are explicit source-reviewed local corrections; 56 retain native Auto geometry. Automatic layout/crop success is not claimed for all 64 without review.
Small isolated neighboring slurs, glyph tips, directions, group brackets and 12 single neighboring staff-line centers remain. No masks were used; source overlap limits rectangular isolation.
Opening Violino I retains partial Basso lyrics at its own Adagio height. Opening Basso retains neighboring Adagio context. These are disclosed overlap cases rather than whole duplicated lyric rows.
Basso ed Organo retains two publisher copyright lines; these are cosmetic source context and do not omit or obscure any figured bass.
No duplicate measure-number glyphs were observed across the 56 numbered strips; all 42 copied source numbers are complete.
Every part is one page, so performance page-turn decisions were not evaluated.
